unlisted_practices: Comparing user-rated performance of an LLM mental health chatbot against other LLM chatbots and existing digital therapy tools
Including a gratitude journal and risk detection features in a mental health chatbot

screen.reason: The study conducts a pilot user experience evaluation of a custom GPT-4-based mental health chatbot with 20 young adults, assessing usability, empathy, and satisfaction compared to existing tools, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparatively.
